title: Admin endpoint: GET /ipns → node IPNS path and group index
description: Add GET /ipns to admin.rs. Calls build_ipns_json(pool, ipfs) which: 1. Gets the node peer_id from ipfs.identity() -> Keypair -> PeerId. 2. Formats the IPNS path as /ipns/<peer-id-as-cid> (base36 encoding). 3. Queries articles table for the most recent cid per group_name. Returns JSON: {"ipns_path":"/ipns/k2...","groups":{"comp.lang.rust":"<cid>"}}. Extend start_admin_server() to accept an optional Arc<rust_ipfs::Ipfs> (Option<Arc<Ipfs>>). If None, return 503 {"error":"ipns not configured"}. Wire ipfs_for_ipns into start_admin_server in main.rs. Why: lets operators find their node's stable IPNS address to share.
